about: A log line as text, in a downloaded file and on the clipboard, as both halves write it: src/tauri/src/logs/text.rs (Download) and logsToText in src/ui/routes/c/$cluster/-logs/types.ts (Copy). `raw` is the line as the terminal shows it; an empty one falls back to the timestamp and the message. The file ends every line with a newline, the last too, as kubectl logs does; the clipboard joins them with nothing after the last.
